hero.html:
Level 4 - Advanced20 minInterview pageRevise the night before

Patterns & Principles Cheat Sheet

The whole LLD toolbox on one page: every pattern with its intent, the words in a problem that signal it, its code shape and a Linux kernel look-alike; the principles; the UML arrows; and a picker for concurrency tools in Java, Python, C++ and the kernel.

All descriptions are written in our own words. Each row links to the full lesson on this site; for a second opinion with diagrams, the refactoring.guru catalogue is a good free reference (link only).
